description: Fork of exp031 (K=4, full votes/pair = exp026 geometry) with bit_lut_latent_init_std 0.001 → 0.1. Fixes the K=4 dead-zone init: with init_std=0.001 all latents quantize to q=0 (uniform +1/16 vote, zero structural signal); takes ~4000 wall steps for latents to escape past |w|=0.0625 boundary. With init_std=0.1, ~75% of latents land outside q=0 immediately → signed votes from step 1. Compare against exp026 (K=1, same geometry, init=0.001) = 1.8415.
